# Junichi Hayashi

> I am Junichi Hayashi, a web engineer working at a company in Tokyo. I love programming and type theory.

I work as a web engineer at a company in Tokyo while enjoying various programming languages and technologies.
Below, I summarize my favorite things and my background.

Favorites:
- Programming: From BASIC to Rust, experience with diverse languages
- Perl: My main work language at the first company, I love its handmade feel
- TypeScript: Rediscovering the convenience of static typing
- Types: Captivated by the Curry-Howard correspondence

Affiliations:
- Kobe City College of Technology: Department of Electrical Engineering, graduated March 2016
- Osaka University, School of Engineering Science: Department of Information Science, graduated March 2018
- Graduate School of Information Science and Technology, Osaka University: Computer Science Master's program, withdrawn October 2019
- Seesaa Inc.: April 2020 – December 2023
- current job: January 2024 - Present
